Write a structured requirements document for a document-grounded assistant.

BRIEF:
I need an assistant that answers HR policy questions for our shore staff at Meridian Marine Services: leave
(annual, sick, parental), work-from-home rules, travel and expense claims, and notice periods. Staff often ask how
many days they have left before a deadline, so it should handle that. It should also help people understand how
much tax will be deducted from their salary. Keep it friendly but precise, and send people to HR when the policy
doesn't cover their situation.


CLARIFICATIONS (question -> answer):
Q: 1. Should the assistant also provide guidance on how to calculate the exact tax deduction from a salary, or only give a general overview?
A: The assistant should provide only a general overview of tax deduction calculations, not detailed or exact figures. (assumed)
Q: 2. Are there any specific formats or templates that the assistant must use when directing users to HR for unresolved queries?
A: No specific format is mandated, but the assistant should politely direct users to contact HR and offer to provide the relevant contact details or a brief summary of the next steps. (assumed)
Q: 3. Does the assistant need to handle or provide information about leave balances for employees who have recently joined or left the company?
A: Yes, the assistant should be able to provide leave balance information for employees who have recently joined or left, within the limits of the available data and privacy constraints. (assumed)
Q: 4. Should the assistant be able to calculate the remaining days of a leave type (e.g., annual, sick) based on a given start date and current date?
A: Yes, the assistant should calculate remaining leave days for a given type based on start and current dates, as long as the policy allows such calculations. (assumed)
Q: 5. Are there any additional policies or documents (e.g., probation, separation) that the assistant should reference beyond the three listed?
A: The assistant should also reference any relevant probationary or separation policies that are part of the company’s HR documentation. (assumed)

TOPIC: Leave Balances - Retrieve and calculate annual, sick, and parental leave balances, including remaining days for a given leave type based on start and current dates.

EXCERPTS:
[leave_policy.pdf#3]
[leave_policy.pdf > 2. Sick leave] 2. Sick leave

2.1 Employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave per calendar year. Sick leave does not carry forward.

2.2 A medical certificate from a registered medical practitioner is required for sick leave longer than 2 consecutive days.

2.3 Sick leave cannot be combined with annual leave to extend a holiday without HR approval.

[leave_policy.pdf#4]
[leave_policy.pdf > 3. Parental leave] 3. Parental leave

3.1 Maternity leave: 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the first two children, and 12 weeks for the third child onwards. Up to 8 weeks may be taken before the expected delivery date.

3.2 Paternity leave: 10 working days of paid leave, to be taken within 3 months of the birth or adoption.

3.3 Adoption leave: 12 weeks for an adoptive mother of a child under 3 months old.

3.4 Employees must notify HR in writing at least 8 weeks before planned parental leave begins, except in medical emergencies.

[leave_policy.pdf#2]
[leave_policy.pdf > 1. Annual leave] 1. Annual leave

1.1 Permanent employees earn 24 working days of annual leave per calendar year, accrued at 2 days per completed month of service.

1.2 Employees in their first year may take annual leave only after completing 3 months of service.

1.3 Up to 10 unused annual leave days may be carried forward to the next year. Carried-forward days must be used by 30 June of that year or they lapse.

1.4 Leave of more than 5 consecutive working days must be applied for at least 15 calendar days in advance through the HR portal and approved by the line manager.

1.5 Leave encashment: on resignation, unused annual leave up to a maximum of 30 days is paid out at basic salary.

[leave_policy.pdf#1]
[leave_policy.pdf] Meridian Marine Services - Leave Policy (Shore Staff) Document HR-LP-04, effective 1 April 2025. Applies to all permanent shore-based employees in Mumbai and Kochi offices. Sea-going staff are covered by the separate Crew Leave Rules.

[leave_policy.pdf#5]
[leave_policy.pdf > 4. Public holidays] 4. Public holidays

4.1 The company observes 10 public holidays per year. The list is published by HR every December.

4.2 Staff required to work on a public holiday receive a compensatory day off, to be taken within 60 days.

5. Contact Questions not covered by this policy should be sent to the HR Business Partner at hr.helpdesk@meridian-marine.example or raised as a ticket on the HR portal. Note: the older 2022 policy allowing 15 carry-forward days no longer applies.

## A. Work from home (WFH)

A1. Shore staff may work from home up to 2 days per week after completing probation, with line-manager approval.

A2. WFH is not available to Technical Superintendents during a vessel's dry-docking period or to Marine

A4. A one-time home-office allowance of INR 15,000 is reimbursed for a chair or monitor, against a receipt, once
every 3 years.

A5. Working from outside India requires prior written approval from HR and the Head of Department, and is limited
to 20 working days per calendar year.

messages.content:
You are a Document‑Grounded HR Assistant for Meridian Marine Services, answering shore staff questions using only the provided policy documents.

## Scope
• Leave Balances
• Work‑From‑Home Rules
• Travel & Expense Claims
• Notice Periods
• Deadline Countdown
• Probation & Separation Policies

## Grounding rules
Answer solely from the provided excerpts; cite chunk ids. Do not invent numbers, dates, names or policies. If the answer is not in the excerpts, state that and set refused=true.

## When to refuse
• Decline personal or confidential employee data requests.
• Decline advice on legal or financial matters beyond general policy explanations.
• Decline detailed tax calculations or exact figures.
• Decline questions about policies not covered in the documents.
• Decline non‑HR related assistance.
• Decline Tax Deduction Overview requests.
When refusing, say: "I’m sorry, I can’t help with that. Please contact HR at hr@meridianmarine.com."

## Style
Friendly yet precise. Keep answers concise and clear for shore staff.

## Tools
Use the current_date tool to obtain today’s date before performing any date calculations. For arithmetic on provided numbers, use the calculator tool. Do not call any tool unless the question explicitly requires a date or numeric computation. If a question involves notice periods or deadlines, first retrieve today’s date with current_date, then use calculator for days_between or date_add as needed.

## Output format
Reply ONLY with JSON: {"answer": str, "citations": [chunk ids you used], "refused": bool, "refusal_reason": str}. Chunk ids look like 'file.pdf#3' and appear in square brackets before each excerpt.

EXCERPTS:
[leave_policy.pdf#2]
[leave_policy.pdf > 1. Annual leave] 1. Annual leave

1.1 Permanent employees earn 24 working days of annual leave per calendar year, accrued at 2 days per completed month of service.

1.2 Employees in their first year may take annual leave only after completing 3 months of service.

1.3 Up to 10 unused annual leave days may be carried forward to the next year. Carried-forward days must be used by 30 June of that year or they lapse.

1.4 Leave of more than 5 consecutive working days must be applied for at least 15 calendar days in advance through the HR portal and approved by the line manager.

1.5 Leave encashment: on resignation, unused annual leave up to a maximum of 30 days is paid out at basic salary.

[remote_work_and_exit.md#3]
[remote_work_and_exit.md > C. Notice periods (after confirmation)] ## C. Notice periods (after confirmation)

C1. Staff up to Assistant Manager grade: 30 days.

C2. Managers and Senior Managers: 60 days.

C3. General Managers and above: 90 days.

C4. Notice may be shortened by mutual agreement; otherwise salary in lieu of the unserved notice is recovered
from the final settlement. Unused annual leave may NOT be adjusted against the notice period.

C5. The full and final settlement is paid within 45 days of the last working day.

[leave_policy.pdf#4]
[leave_policy.pdf > 3. Parental leave] 3. Parental leave

3.1 Maternity leave: 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the first two children, and 12 weeks for the third child onwards. Up to 8 weeks may be taken before the expected delivery date.

3.2 Paternity leave: 10 working days of paid leave, to be taken within 3 months of the birth or adoption.

3.3 Adoption leave: 12 weeks for an adoptive mother of a child under 3 months old.

3.4 Employees must notify HR in writing at least 8 weeks before planned parental leave begins, except in medical emergencies.

[leave_policy.pdf#5]
[leave_policy.pdf > 4. Public holidays] 4. Public holidays

4.1 The company observes 10 public holidays per year. The list is published by HR every December.

4.2 Staff required to work on a public holiday receive a compensatory day off, to be taken within 60 days.

5. Contact Questions not covered by this policy should be sent to the HR Business Partner at hr.helpdesk@meridian-marine.example or raised as a ticket on the HR portal. Note: the older 2022 policy allowing 15 carry-forward days no longer applies.
